_note: Hand-edited. One entry per arm: the vendor's published list price for the hosted product, read from the vendor's own pricing page on the date given. Leave a value null until someone has read the page; the cost table prints TODO for null. Do not guess. Self-hosted open-source arms (mem0 OSS, Letta, Honcho self-hosted) have no list price for what we ran; record the hosted equivalent if you want one in the table.

mem0.plans: Hobby free: 10,000 add + 1,000 retrieval req/mo, 1 project. Starter $19/mo: 50,000 add + 5,000 retrieval/mo, 1 project. Pro $249/mo: 500,000 add + 50,000 retrieval/mo, unlimited projects, private Slack. Enterprise: custom, unlimited, on-prem. Overage: not stated on page (usage-based pricing on inquiry).
mem0.notes: Profile = 600 adds + 100 retrievals per user-month. Starter: adds allow 50000/600=83 users, retrievals allow 5000/100=50 users, so 50 users per plan: $19/50 = $0.38 per user-month (binding limit is retrievals). Pro: 500000/600=833, 50000/100=500 users: $249/500=$0.50. Assumes one add request per turn and plan fully packed with identical users; a fee share, not a per-user charge. Free Hobby covers 1,000/100 = 10 users by retrieval. Mem0's own metering of an add (one request may cover several messages) is not stated on the page.

letta.plans: Free $0: limited agents, limited Letta Auto usage, BYOK. Pro $20/mo: up to 20 stateful agents, pay-as-you-go overage. API plan $20/mo base: unlimited agents, $0.10 per active agent per month, $0.00015 per second of tool execution, LLM usage pay-as-you-go. Teams Pro $20/seat/mo. Enterprise: contact sales, volume-based.
letta.notes: Letta meters agents, tool-seconds and LLM tokens, not memory operations, so the 600-turn/100-recall profile does not map to a price. Floor if each user is one agent on the API plan: $0.10/user-month agent fee + share of $20 base + LLM at provider rates (not stated as a list price); LLM share not computable, so left null. Older docs pages (docs.letta.com/guides/cloud/plans) show a different credits model (Pro $20 = 20,000 credits, Scale $750); the letta.com/pricing redirect target was used.

honcho_retrieval.plans: Honcho Memory: ingestion (store + reasoning) $2.00 per 1M tokens; context() reads unlimited, ~200ms; dreaming included. Honcho Reasoning (dialectic chat) per query: Minimal $0.001, Low $0.01, Medium $0.05, High $0.10, Max $0.50. Startups under $5M raised: $1,000 credits, 12 months subsidized. Enterprise: custom.
honcho_retrieval.notes: Retrieval arm = context() reads, which are free: 100 recalls x $0 = $0. Ingestion = 600 turns x tokens/turn x $2/1M; tokens per turn is not in the repo's cost code (only turn counts), so per-user-month is not computed. Formula: 600 x T x 2e-6 USD; e.g. T=100 tokens/turn gives $0.12 (illustration only, not measured). No monthly fee found. Separate honcho.dev docs pricing URL returned 404.

honcho_chat.plans: Honcho Memory: ingestion (store + reasoning) $2.00 per 1M tokens; context() reads unlimited, ~200ms; dreaming included. Honcho Reasoning (dialectic chat) per query: Minimal $0.001, Low $0.01, Medium $0.05, High $0.10, Max $0.50. Startups under $5M raised: $1,000 credits, 12 months subsidized. Enterprise: custom.
honcho_chat.notes: Chat arm = Reasoning queries. 100 recalls/mo x per-query price: Minimal $0.10, Low $1.00, Medium $5.00, High $10.00, Max $50.00 per user-month, plus ingestion 600 x T x $2/1M (T tokens/turn, not known here). Tier used by the driver is not recorded in the price file, so no single figure is set.

zep.plans: Free $0: 10,000 credits/mo, no rollover, 2 projects. Flex $125/mo: 50,000 credits, overage $25 per 10,000, 600 req/min. Flex Plus $375/mo: 200,000 credits, overage $75 per 40,000, 1,000 req/min. Enterprise: custom, contact sales.
zep.notes: Credit cost per message/episode/retrieval not read from the page, so the 600-turn/100-recall profile is not converted. Reference only; not a benchmark arm.

supermemory.plans: Free $0 ($5 credits). Pro $19/mo ($20 credits). Max $100/mo ($130 credits). Scale $399/mo ($600 credits). Enterprise: custom, contact sales. Rate card: Memory plain text $5/1M tokens, rich $10/1M; SuperRAG text $1/1M, rich $2/1M; search $5/1M queries; operations $100/1M.
supermemory.notes: Ingest = 600 x T x $5/1M (T tokens/turn unknown); search = 100 x $5/1M = $0.0005. Not converted without T. Reference only; not a benchmark arm.
